messages:
alex_k: quick heads-up: PR #8581 (microbatch scheduler tweak) triggered a p95 bump on a small-batch longseq canary, need sync on next steps. bench link: https://perf.redwood/bench/3626
mira: can you paste the exact bench config + model + hardware? :thinking:
alex_k: tl;dr: model=llama-70b-4q, seq=2048, batch-horizon changed 4->8, config flag `--microbatch-horizon=8 --pkv-eviction=smart`. ran on g4dn-like instance. results: p50 ~unchanged, p95 jumped 28ms -> 45ms (1k samples). full logs: https://perf.redwood/bench/3626/details
ben: ouch. did you run old vs new binary side-by-side? we need a controlled A/B to be sure it's not noise
sasha: also include scheduler trace and affinity details; packing changes sometimes move hot shards around
alex_k: ran side-by-side yesterday: old binary p95 29ms, new binary p95 45ms. uploaded flamegraphs + `perf` samples to bench details. scheduler trace here: https://traces.redwood/3626
deploy-bot: Canary run 3626 finished — success rate 79%, p95=45ms (baseline p95=28ms). No infra-level errors logged.
mira: paste the exact command you used for microbench please
alex_k: command used:
```
./run_microbench --model llama-70b-4q --seq 2048 --batch-horizon 8 --iters 1000 --warmup 200
```
jeff: can we correlate with KV cache/shard sizing? if packing increased shards, tail could go up due to cross-shard overhead
sasha: PR diff looks small but touches allocator heuristics. request: run with `--prefill-kv=false` to see if prefill path is the regression
alex_k: running that now, will post numbers in ~15m
mira: FYI adding @eng-sre for visibility in case we need a quick rollback plan
ben: if the numbers don't get better, hold merge and request a revert. also tag runtime-core for second opinion @sasha
alex_k: update: run with `--prefill-kv=false` completed — p95 dropped to 31ms (from 45ms). suggests prefill path is the main contributor
mira: good isolate. please attach a revert or gate for the prefill change — gating is safer if the fix is more involved
alex_k: opened follow-up PR to gate prefill behind a flag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/8610 (small diff, adds feature flag and fallback)
ben: I'll hold my LGTM on the original PR until 8610 lands and passes canary. adding hold comment on the PR. :+1:
sasha: reviewing PR 8610 now, will prioritize since it's blocking merge
alex_k: thanks all — will post canary results for 8610 here once it runs. appreciate the quick sync. :pray:
